verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs, which cover Terminal payments, describe registrable HTTPS webhook endpoints. Stripe pushes real-time events to them so an integration can trigger reactions automatically, which is the core mechanism this story needs. The pack never names the specific lifecycle event types or ties webhook delivery to Terminal in-person payments. missing for 10: documented event types for authorization, capture, refund and dispute; explicit evidence that Terminal payments emit these webhook events; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to payment lifecycle events (authorized, captured, refunded, disputed) via webhooks to drive downstream automations

citations.quote: After you register a webhook endpoint, Stripe pushes real-time data to it when events occur.
You can create an HTTPS webhook endpoint to receive events.
